title: Russo-Turkish War (1568–1570)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Russo-Turkish War (1568–1570)", at revision 1382437683, opens: "The Russo-Turkish War (1568–1570) or Don-Volga-Astrakhan campaign of 1569 was a war between the Tsardom of Russia and the Ottoman Empire over the Astrakhan Khanate. It was the first of twelve Russo-Turkish wars ending with World War I in 1914–18." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q631799, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1568-1570 part of the Russo-Turkish Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
